newsitem.title: USA: Bullet Sports seeking additional finances.
newsitem.headline: Bullet Sports seeking additional finances.

text.p: Bullet Sports International Inc said it will incur charges in the third quarter if it is unable to come up with alternative financing sources.

In a statement accompanying its second quarter results, the golf equipment manufacturer said "substantial charges" were accrued during the second quarter relating to payments which may be claimed by various preferred stockholders holding registration rights relating to convertible preferred stock issued during the first quarter.

Unless the company is able to get these payment obligations waived or substantially reduced, additional charges will be incurred during the third quarter, until the registration statement becomes effective with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The company said it expects to file the statement within the next few days but no assurance can be given as to when it would become effective.
